Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Mirrors

镜子

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like looking at yourself in the mirror? How often?

Not really, to be honest. I only glance in the mirror about once a day, usually to check my hair before leaving home. I'm not really a vain person, so I never spend long there.

不太爱照镜子，一天大概一次，出门前看看头发，不是爱臭美的人。

Q2Have you ever bought mirrors?

No, I don't think I have. There's already a full-length mirror at home, so I've never felt the need to buy one myself. It's just not something that crosses my mind when I'm shopping.

从没买过镜子，家里本来就有穿衣镜，买东西时根本想不起来。

Q3Do you usually take a mirror with you?

No, never. When I'm out and want to check my appearance, I just use my phone camera. A small mirror would only take up space in my bag, so I don't bother.

不会带，出门想照就用手机摄像头，小镜子只会占包里的地方。

Q4Would you use mirrors to decorate your room?

Probably not. Mirrors don't really appeal to me as decoration, and since I rarely look at myself anyway, they wouldn't serve much of a purpose. I'd rather put up posters or something like that.

大概不会，镜子当装饰不吸引我，反正也不照，宁愿挂海报。
